name: OFFDaPorch Roleplay (TESTING)
desc:
Welcome to OFFDaPorch Roleplay

🌆 Experience one of the most immersive Chicago Roleplay games on Roblox. Inspired by FiveM, Chicago Lands lets you create your own story in a living city where every choice matters.

Choose Your Path

🚔 Police – Protect the city and stop crime.
🏙️ Civilian – Own businesses, make money, and build your reputation.
🔫 Criminal – Form a crew, take over neighborhoods, and rise to the top.

Features

• Realistic Chicago-inspired map
• Advanced roleplay systems
• Vehicles and businesses
• Frequent updates and new content
• Console, PC & Mobile support
• Active community with events

💥 Can you survive the streets and build your legacy?

👍 Like and ⭐ Favorite the game to support future updates and help us grow!

👨‍💻 Developer: FlockaSpinnin & Mugshot
